title: kubesentry health
description: kubesentry's own health: snapshot, HTTP, caches, authorization budget, audit ingest, agents and the Go runtime.

list.name: authz_qps
list.description: SubjectAccessReviews per second per replica (auth.authzQPS); the chart fills it in.

list.name: audit_queue_cap
list.description: Capacity of the Postgres audit write queue; the chart fills it in.

panels.title: Snapshot age (oldest)
panels.description: Seconds since the oldest replica last rebuilt its view. The view rebuilds only on change, so a quiet cluster shows a rising age.

panels.title: Review budget used (busiest replica)
panels.description: SubjectAccessReviews per second on the busiest replica, as a share of auth.authzQPS (a per-replica budget).

panels.title: Nodes reporting processes
panels.description: Nodes whose process agent reported recently.

panels.title: Snapshot age
panels.description: Age of the view each replica serves. It counts quiet time too: the view only rebuilds when a watched object changes.

panels.title: Snapshot build time
panels.description: Time to rebuild a view. KubesentrySnapshotBuildSlow fires on the p90.

panels.title: View rebuilds per minute
panels.description: Rebuilds are debounced (server.snapshotMinInterval, snapshotMaxDelay). Every rebuild invalidates the response cache.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (route, le) (rate(kubesentry_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: 429 and 5xx by route
panels.description: Per-route rejections. The per-identity rate limit and the max-inflight cap answer before a route is known and are not counted here.

targets.expr: sum by (route, code) (rate(kubesentry_http_requests_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", code=~"429|5.."}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Response cache hit ratio
panels.description: Hits and coalesced lookups over all cacheable lookups (skips excluded). Entries are keyed by the view version, so frequent rebuilds lower it.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(kubesentry_http_cache_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", result=~"hit|coalesced"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (pod) (rate(kubesentry_http_cache_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", result=~"hit|coalesced|miss"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (pod) (rate(kubesentry_authz_cache_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", result=~"hit|coalesced"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (pod) (rate(kubesentry_authz_cache_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (pod) (rate(kubesentry_prometheus_cache_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", result=~"hit|shared"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (pod) (rate(kubesentry_prometheus_cache_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: SubjectAccessReviews per replica against the budget
panels.description: The budget is per replica. Stress Phase 4 saturated it at 1,000 to 2,000 distinct users while CPU stayed low. KubesentryAuthzBudgetNearLimit fires at 80% by default.

panels.title: Kubernetes API requests by verb and resource
panels.description: With the informer cache, reads are watches; LISTs appear only at start-up and after watch errors. SubjectAccessReviews are the creates.

panels.title: Audit write queue (Postgres)
panels.description: Events waiting for Postgres. At capacity the webhook answers 503 and the CloudWatch reader slows down; nothing is lost.

panels.title: CloudWatch reader lag
panels.description: Only the replica holding the reader lock reads; a replica that lost the lock may keep showing its last value.

panels.title: Nodes with a fresh agent report
Prometheus query latency p95 by kind

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (kind, le) (rate(kubesentry_prometheus_query_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Go memory
panels.description: GOMEMLIMIT is 90% of the container memory limit.

panels.title: Container working set
panels.description: From cAdvisor (the kubelet), which the OOM killer compares with the limit.

targets.expr: max by (pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container=~"server|oauth2-proxy"})

panels.title: GC CPU
panels.description: Estimated cores spent in the garbage collector. It climbs as the heap nears GOMEMLIMIT.
